description: Create (without cockpit_id) or update a cockpit. outpost_ids from list_clients (omit = all outposts the user can see). status=archived / active. definition = which widgets to show and optional custom traffic-light thresholds: {schema:"cockpit.v2", widgets:[{key}], rules?:{rosso?:{...}, giallo?:{...}}}; read the catalog and the allowed ranges with list_cockpit_widgets first; omit definition = classic cockpit. visibility: private (only the creator sees it) | org (whole organization) | public. Owners/admins can create any visibility; members only private cockpits on the outposts assigned to them, and can edit only their own. Default visibility: org for owners/admins, private for members. Max 10 active shared cockpits per organization plus 10 active private per user (limit_reached). Show the user name, outposts and widgets before saving.

confirm_id.description: Token di conferma ritornato dall'anteprima. Ripassa lo STESSO payload + confirm_id per eseguire davvero la scrittura.

definition.description: cockpit.v2 definition (see list_cockpit_widgets). Max 20 widgets, 8 KB.

rules.description: Optional custom thresholds {rosso:{...}, giallo:{...}} within the ranges of list_cockpit_widgets.

widgets.description: Widgets to show, in order (keys from list_cockpit_widgets).

key.description: Widget key, e.g. sales_target, stockout, buybox.

outpost_ids.description: Elenco di id outpost (seller × marketplace), array di stringhe.

visibility.description: private = only the creator; org = whole organization; public = shared in the organization and flagged for the future cockpit marketplace (owner/admin only).

name: save_cockpit
